title: biological-rhythms-dataset/rhythms@1
description: data/rhythms.yaml after YAML merge keys are applied: measured frequencies and timings of early life, one entry per measurement in one species, each with its method and sources. scripts/build.py also checks what a schema cannot: unique ids, the species named in each id and description, known source keys, min < max, and consistent series.

series.description: Named groups of entries that a helper function reads, with what each entry's `at` means.

at.description: What `at` measures for entries in this series.

offset.description: Added to each entry's `at` to give the position a helper reads it at, such as 0.5 to place the median of a completed week at mid-week. Default 0.

shared.description: Field groups merged into entries with YAML merge keys. Not part of the data.

id.description: The claim id: permanent once published. HUMAN- or MOUSE- must match `species`.

version.description: The claim version (default 1.0.0). Bump the major version whenever the measurement's meaning changes.

quantity.description: What was measured, naming the species in plain words (human or mouse).

kind.description: period: time between repeats; frequency: repeats per second; rate: repeats per minute; duration: length of one event; time: time after a reference event; stage: a number of cells; count: a number of things.

statistic.description: What the number is: a mean or median, the range reported, an approximate or estimated value, the value observed, or the value as reported without a stated statistic.

stage.description: The developmental stage or condition measured.

n_unit.description: What n counts, e.g. 'cells from 3 donors'.

at.description: This entry's position in its series, in the series' `at` units.

sources.description: Keys in data/sources.yaml; the first is the source of the value.

contested.description: Why the value is disputed or has been revised, with the sources that disagree.
